sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Brings in column types including a large integer, the link to the shared base and the portable UUID type.
sections.why: Likely reason: the table classes below need these tools.
sections.watch_out: The large integer type for file size must stay large enough for big exports.

sections.name: Export
sections.title: Generated export file record
sections.what: Defines the table recording each generated export, with its type, name, location, size, citation count and the runs behind it.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets a delivered file be traced to its inputs.
sections.watch_out: The file location is stored, but removing the file on disk leaves the row behind.

sections.name: ReasoningChain
sections.title: Explanation trail table
sections.what: Defines the table holding ordered explanation steps for one result, with links to the sources and extracts used.
sections.why: Likely reason: supports the View Reasoning feature so a user can see how a number was reached.
sections.watch_out: Steps are stored as JSON, and the display code is not shown here, so the step format is known only from comments.

summary: Defines two tables: one for each exported file, and one for the reasoning chains that explain results.
purpose: Records which export files were made, from which model and run, and stores the explanation trail behind the View Reasoning feature.
why: Likely reason: exported files must be traceable back to the runs that produced them.
how: 1) Export rows store the type, file name, location, size, citation count and links to run IDs. 2) Reasoning chain rows store an ordered list of steps and the source IDs behind them.
inputs: Written by export and reasoning code.
outputs: Rows in the exports and reasoning_chains tables.
risks: The file location is stored, but deleting the file on disk does not delete the row. The normalization ID is plain text, not a link, so it can point at nothing.
debug: If an export record exists but the file is missing, check file_path. If reasoning does not appear, check the steps and target_entity values.
